issues.title: Vague segment name
issues.why: “Segment A” tells nobody who is in it or why. A good name carries the priority and the audience, so sales and leadership read it the same way.

issues.title: A P1 sales list with no intent signal and 15,000 contacts
issues.why: P1 means “call these people first.” Without a behavior such as a webinar or pricing visit, this is really an awareness list, and sales cannot work 15,000 contacts.

issues.title: OR used without parentheses
issues.why: Without grouping, a platform may read this as “(Retail AND 50–500 AND Operations Manager) OR Marketing Analyst” and pull in marketing analysts from every company. Group the options: (Title: Operations Manager OR Marketing Analyst).

issues.title: Priority does not match the name
issues.why: The name says P3 but the priority says P2. Anyone sorting by priority would put an awareness audience in the nurture tier.

issues.title: Criteria that no platform can filter on
issues.why: Attitudes like “cares about the environment” are not fields in a CRM or an ad platform. Use a proxy you can actually filter, such as downloaded the sustainability report.

issues.title: Missing size estimate
issues.why: Without a size you cannot tell whether the segment is worth a campaign. That is the whole point of the Estimated Size column.

issues.title: Over-filtered down to 3 contacts
issues.why: Four filters, including a day of the week, leave a segment too small to justify a campaign. Drop the region and blog-day filters and keep the ones that define the persona.

issues.title: Vague value: “Large”
issues.why: “Large” means different things to different people. Use a number range, such as 50–500 employees, so anyone can rebuild the segment the same way.

fixes.1,3: Industry: Retail AND Size: 50–500 employees AND Behavior: Attended product webinar in last 30 days
fixes.2,3: Industry: Retail AND Size: 50–500 employees AND (Title: Operations Manager OR Marketing Analyst)
fixes.4,3: Industry: Retail AND Behavior: Downloaded sustainability report
fixes.5,3: Industry: Retail AND Size: 50–500 employees AND Title: BI Analyst
fixes.6,3: Industry: Retail AND Size: 50–500 employees AND Title: E-commerce Manager
